definitions.gloss: road shoulder; roadside; edge of the road
definitions.explanation: The paved or unpaved strip along the edge of a road, outside the main traffic lanes. Used for emergency stops, breakdowns, or pedestrians where no sidewalk exists.

examples.japanese: {路肩|ろかた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|と}めた→止める：00678_tomeru⟧。
examples.english: I pulled over to the road shoulder.

examples.japanese: ⟦{故障|こしょう}した→故障する：01826_koshousuru⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{路肩|ろかた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{停|と}まって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: A broken-down car is stopped on the road shoulder.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}→高速道路：09242_kousokudouro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{路肩|ろかた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{駐車|ちゅうしゃ}する→駐車する：22431_chuushasuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{緊急時|きんきゅうじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{除|のぞ}いて→除く：02391_nozoku⟧⟦やめて→やめる：00909_yameru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Parking on the highway shoulder is extremely dangerous, so please don't do it except in emergencies.

notes:
Composed of {路|ろ} (road) + ⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧ (shoulder). The metaphor of 'shoulder' for the edge of a road exists in both Japanese and English.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {路肩|ろかた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{止|と}める→止める：00678_tomeru⟧: to pull over to the shoulder
- {路肩|ろかた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寄|よ}せる→寄せる：02329_yoseru⟧: to move to the shoulder
- {路肩|ろかた}⟦{走行|そうこう}→走行：14260_soukou⟧: driving on the shoulder (illegal on highways)
- {路肩|ろかた}⟦{駐車|ちゅうしゃ}→駐車：01466_chuusha⟧: parking on the shoulder

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{歩道|ほどう}→歩道：03723_hodou⟧: sidewalk — a separate path for pedestrians
- ⟦{車道|しゃどう}→車道：03066_shadou⟧: roadway — the portion of the road for vehicles
- {側道|そくどう}: side road — a narrow road running parallel to a main road

USAGE:
On Japanese highways (⟦{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}→高速道路：09242_kousokudouro⟧), driving or stopping on the {路肩|ろかた} is prohibited except in genuine emergencies. {路肩|ろかた}⟦{走行|そうこう}→走行：14260_soukou⟧ (shoulder driving) during traffic jams is a traffic violation.
